value.summary: The behavioural changes are either tested in the new summarise.rs module (which has in-crate tests covering truncation, word boundaries, and multibyte characters) or are deployment configuration/environment changes that fail loudly (the kernel bypass script exits with a message if the image changes shape) or are configuration-only (docker-compose environment variables and volume mount, .tinysweeper.toml). No change can silently regress in a way that would be caught by a missing test; the new tests earn their keep.
